gorge.note: 关北 A (剧情总纲 §6 关北卡, doc/help/plan:19): the military road out of 天驼关's valley by the gate in its east wall — behind the gate the road bends north round the camel's east hump between low pale cliffs (关外山道), the cliffs fall back and the earth turns to dust under a wide sky (风沙道), and the grass begins at the fief's boundary stone (关北界碑) with 槐阳城's earth wall across the north. The south passage is the gate back into canyon7; the north one the city gate.

town.note: 关北 A: 槐阳城 — the south gate in the earth wall (the caravan's yard inside it, the two gate guards, the 王府's notice), the 王府大街 north from it between the smith's, the furrier's and the saddler's low mud-brick fronts (the market's lane off its east side), and the front of 槐阳王府 at the north end: the faded red gate, the two stone drums. The 王府's door opens in 关北 B.

market.note: 关北 A: the 马市 east of the street — the horse pen with its rails and a dozen steppe ponies, two tethered at the posts, the camel pen on the south side, the trader's steelyard, 卢卡 on his cloth by the pen's south-east corner; the 塞外酒肆's low front on the north side with its wine flag (an interior map). The 东门 in the east wall opens onto the camp (关北 C).

ground: the market's east wall, north of the 东门
props: two tethered at the posts, just sold
the trader's steelyard on its frame
an empty cart by the lane
a water trough by the lane

inn.note: 关北 A: the 塞外酒肆 — a mud-walled hall with a hearth sunk in its middle, a black pot over it, low tables and benches, the keeper's chopping block and counter on the east, skins and whips on the walls; the back room north of it with the fodder, the wine vats and the keeper's felt bed.

palace_court.note: 关北 B: 槐阳王府's forecourt behind the red gate — the whitewashed screen wall just inside, the swept yard (the one clean place in town), three steps up to the hall's door on the north; east of it the drill yard with its row of hacked wooden posts, the butts, the hitching rail, where 郭承 drills the men. The south door is the 王府大门 (a WorldDoor found by 王府放行).

props: the whitewashed screen wall inside the gate (影壁)

palace.note: 关北 B: the 王府's hall — brick floor, the old camp chair with its worn tiger skin at the north end, the weapon rack beside it (saber above, sword below), the two guards, 程朔 on the chair and, on the 保密 ledger, 南危水 at his side; east of it the side hall where he reads: the desk with the 兵部's letter slashed across, the sheepskin map with the 工地 ringed in red, a brazier.

camp.note: 关北 C: the 帐篷营地 outside the 马市's 东门 — five yurts in a loose ring on the grass, the fire in the middle where the families wait, the sheep pen with its willow hurdles, the hitching posts and the trough at the east mouth where the steppe road goes out.

worksite.note: 关北 C: the 兵部's 工地 on the steppe — a fence across the grass with the gate in it (the officers and 吕隼 with his roll inside the gate by day), three tents north under the 兵部's white flags, two long sheds south with the shackle posts before them and the watch fire, the diggings east with their pits, the windlass and the spoil heaps, the barrow's mouth beyond.
